Proper motions

The field-level proper-motion map shows the wide Gaia selection, while the member panels show the clustered subset adopted for each open cluster.

HR diagrams

The member-selected HR diagrams show the different main-sequence and evolved-star morphologies across the three clusters.

Turn-off markers

The red circles mark the simple turn-off proxy defined from the bluest median colour in binned absolute magnitude.

Age ordering

The CSV-based age order is Pleiades < Praesepe < M67.

The bootstrap order fractions for the colour and luminosity measures are listed below.

M67 is clearly the oldest; the Pleiades-Praesepe step is not statistically resolved by the simple turn-off measures. Between the Pleiades and Praesepe, red-clump giants and a white-dwarf sequence appear in Praesepe but not in the Pleiades (one possible white-dwarf candidate). M67 also has a red clump, and the Pleiades retain the bluer and brighter main-sequence end.

Method

Gaia rows were fetched with the filters parallax/parallax_error > 5, ruwe < 1.4, and non-null Gaia G, BP, and RP photometry, using cone radii of 10, 5, and 1 deg for Pleiades, Praesepe, and M67. Member finding started from a pre-selection within proper-motion windows of 15, 15, and 10 mas/yr for Pleiades, Praesepe, and M67, together with a parallax window within 30% of the expected value. The final member choice used HDBSCAN on standardized (pmra, pmdec, parallax) with min_cluster_size=50 and min_samples=10. Absolute magnitude was defined as M_G = phot_g_mean_mag + 5*log10(parallax/100) with parallax in mas. The turn-off proxy used 0.25 mag bins, at least 5 stars per bin, and the bluest median BP-RP in the range -1 < M_G < 6. The 5th-brightest luminosity measure used stars with BP-RP < 1.0 for Pleiades and Praesepe, and BP-RP < 0.95 plus M_G > 2.5 for M67.

Limitations

  • Bootstrap resampling captures sampling noise only.
  • No reddening correction or binary-star correction is applied.
  • The +0.017 mas parallax shift is an approximate global zero-point correction.
  • Distances are based on the simple 1/parallax conversion.
  • The turn-off proxy is weak when the cluster HR diagram does not show a clean knee.
  • The BP-RP cuts used for the luminosity measure were chosen by eye.

Isochrone ages: not done yet

No isochrone summary file is present.

Literature ages for context only, not a result of this analysis: Pleiades about 110 Myr, Praesepe about 650 Myr, and M67 about 4 Gyr.
